name: MIAC Cross Country Championships
headline: MIAC Cross Country Championships
summary: Final: Carleton won the women's title with 25 points, 38 ahead of St. Olaf (63) and Macalester (74), while Macalester senior Ingrid Norquist won the individual race in 21:48.6 over 6K. St. Olaf took the men's title with 36 points for its fifth straight MIAC crown and 16th overall, 52 points clear of Carleton (88), which edged Saint John's (92) for second. Saint John's Cole Stencel won the men's race in 24:56.1, 13 seconds ahead of St. Olaf's Garrett Seppanen (25:09.9).
